subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Should Control UI profile import become a review-only draft that persists only through Save & Publish, while explicit non-UI `autoMerge: true` callers retain immediate persistence?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically supportable, but choosing whether Import from Relays itself is a persistence action changes the shipped user interaction and cannot be resolved safely from implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Adopt draft imports
options.body: Accept the PR’s safer review-first interaction while preserving immediate persistence as an explicit HTTP opt-in.

options.title: Retain immediate persistence
options.body: Keep the existing Control UI behavior and instead redesign Cancel and edit locking so users cannot dismiss or race an in-flight persistent import.

recommendation.title: Adopt draft imports
recommendation.body: Accept the PR’s safer review-first interaction while preserving immediate persistence as an explicit HTTP opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Nostr profile implementation history makes this person the strongest available owner for the intended persistence interaction.
